text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
We've got new arcade cabinets in stock! 
Please come give them a spin, okay?

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Its name is the "Red Champion"! It's a 
state-of-the-art kicking machine that can 
even withstand an Umamusume's leg 
strength!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if you're interested, please come over 
here! Feel free to kick with all your 
might~!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You seek the King's full power? ...Hmph, 
an admirable mindset.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, indulging in your little 
diversion sounds amusing enough. —Open 
your eyes and bear witness."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...This will not serve as a record. 
Quickly, bring a replacement device."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre got so absorbed in the kick 
machine that she completely forgot about 
her training.
